items: Example: a goal used in football

exercises.instruction: Fill the gaps with a suitable word.
items: 1 I love sport. In the summer I ......................... tennis and in the winter I ......................... a lot of skiing.
3 It wasn't a dirty game but the ......................... still booked five players in the second half.
4 At the end of the game about 500 ......................... climbed over the fence and ran onto the ......................... to cheer the players off and celebrate their 2–0 victory.
5 In the final of the tennis, the problem started when the ......................... overruled the linesman and gave the point to Hingis.
